label: HEC-05 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene HEC-05 Hma-embedded candidate locus, encoding a GmrSD-like protein closely matching BrxU, that can reduce bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual GmrSD-like or BrxU proteins, the source database row naming one HEC-05 model, the DefenseFinder HEC-05 HMM profile row, unresolved HEC-05 effector chemistry, the absent DefenseFinder HEC-05 rules row, and other Hma-embedded candidate or phage-defense systems.
